description: This Java class defines a custom exception called InvalidCharactersPasswordException used to indicate that a password contains invalid characters according to certain validation rules within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: InvalidCharactersPasswordException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PasswordException, indicating invalid characters in a password.

methods.name: InvalidCharactersPasswordException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating a weak password error.

methods.name: InvalidCharactersPasswordException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom error message.
